title: YVB Catalog
description: A client project built for Yogeshwar Vasan Bhandar, developed using Flutter-based offline catalog application for a kitchenware retail brand. Enables fast product browsing, category navigation, and wishlist management with local data storage, requiring no login or internet connection. Optimized for performance and smooth user experience.

title: LitRate
description: A sleek cross-platform book discovery app built with Compose Multiplatform. Browse titles, view ratings and details, and enjoy a smooth unified experience across Android, iOS, and desktop using shared Kotlin logic with MVVM and RESTful API.

title: Notes
description: A clean, fast Flutter app for simple notes and to-dos. Create, edit, and delete timestamped notes, manage to-do lists with check/uncheck and swipe-to-delete, and multi-select for quick cleanup. Works fully offline with local data storage via Hive.

title: Glidr Beta
description: A modern Android gallery app built with Jetpack Compose. Zoom, swipe, and explore your media with beautiful layouts like vertical, horizontal, and staggered grid. Includes an intuitive image viewer with file info and smooth navigation.

title: MKMP (E-Commerce)
description: A medium-scale e-commerce system, contributed in its development during my internship at Amri Systems. Built with Django and optimized for performance, it includes advanced cart logic, exchange functionality, and real-time updates for both guest and authenticated users.

title: RemoteSync
description: Built a cross-platform remote PC access solution using Flutter and FastAPI. Enables real-time PC control from mobile and desktop with secure, low-latency communication. Features a responsive UI, REST-based architecture, and inbuilt PC-side scripting for seamless APK connectivity.

title: Spotify Clone
description: A fully-functional music streaming application inspired by Spotify, built to showcase scalable architecture, real-time streaming, and a modern Flutter UI.

title: TodoNest
description: A modern, minimalistic task management app built with Flutter.TodoNest helps you stay organized, productive, and in control of your daily tasks with an elegant interface and seamless experience across Android and iOS.
